steps.title: Make the center crease
steps.instruction: Take an 8.5 by 11 inch sheet of paper. Fold it in half as demonstrated, then open it again.
steps.additional_guidance: Draft timing. Check the video to confirm the fold direction and exact pause point.

steps.title: Fold the top down
steps.instruction: Fold the top down, leaving a little more than one inch at the bottom.
steps.additional_guidance: Compare the fold position with the demonstration before creasing.

steps.title: Refold the top section
steps.instruction: Open the top fold. Fold down along the line you just made, then follow the next fold in the demonstration.
steps.additional_guidance: Needs visual review: the transcript is unclear about the additional fold near 31 seconds. Confirm its direction and adjust this segment boundary.

steps.title: Fold triangles toward the center
steps.instruction: Fold both sides toward the center to form the triangles shown in the video.
steps.additional_guidance: Use the demonstration to identify the edges that meet the center crease.

steps.title: Fold to the new creases
steps.instruction: Open the triangle folds. Fold each side to the creases you just made, as demonstrated.
steps.additional_guidance: Needs visual review: confirm which edge aligns with which crease.

steps.title: Tuck the layers and fold in half
steps.instruction: Tuck the layers into the central pocket and lay the paper flat. Fold the model in half along the center crease.
steps.additional_guidance: Check the pocket and layer orientation against the demonstration.

steps.title: Form the wings
steps.instruction: Follow the demonstration to fold the wings, then open the airplane into its flying shape.
steps.additional_guidance: Needs visual review: the transcript does not specify the wing fold lines or angles.

steps.title: Try a flight
steps.instruction: Give the finished airplane a gentle throw into a clear space.
steps.additional_guidance: Choose a clear direction away from other people.
